newsitem.title: UK: Lasmo gains as Hoare Govett upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Lasmo gains as Hoare Govett upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Lasmo Plc rose on Tuesday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett upgraded the stock on the back of its announcement of a new natural gas field in Pakistan, dealers said.

Hoare Govett raised Lasmo to "hold" from "sell" and upped its net asset value on the stock to 195p per share from 185p, sources said, though analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
Lasmo shares were up 11p at 234 by 1028 GMT in active trade of 4.8 million shares, rebounding from the four-month low of 215p set Monday.

Earlier the oil exploration group's chief operating officer John Hogan said the Pakistan drilling "has confirmed the presence of an excellent hydrocarbon province and has increased the attractiveness of several other prospects..."
